description: This file implements conflict detection for Font Awesome resources, including web fonts and JavaScript scripts, by dynamically injecting diagnostic iframes and reporting conflicts via postMessage. It contains functions for MD5 hashing, DOM readiness, conflict detection logic, and configuration management.
